definitions.gloss: combination skin; a mixed skin type (oily in some areas, dry in others)
definitions.explanation: A skin type in which different parts of the face have different characteristics — most commonly oily in the T-zone (forehead, nose, chin) and dry or normal on the cheeks. Standard category in Japanese skincare, alongside {脂性肌|しせいはだ}, {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}, and {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{混合肌|こんごうはだ}だ。
{混合肌|こんごうはだ}のスキンケアは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Skincare for combination skin is tricky.

examples.japanese: {混合肌|こんごうはだ}の{場合|ばあい}、Tゾーンには{皮脂|ひし}{対策|たいさく}の{化粧水|けしょうすい}を、{頬|ほお}には{保湿力|ほしつりょく}の{高|たか}いクリームを{使|つか}い{分|わ}けるとよい。
examples.english: For combination skin, it's a good idea to use separate products — a sebum-control toner for the T-zone and a highly moisturizing cream for the cheeks.

notes:
Compound of {混合|こんごう} ('mixture; combination') and {肌|はだ} ('skin'). Widely used in cosmetics marketing and skincare columns to describe faces that have both oily and dry areas at the same time.

USAGE:
- Japanese skincare routines often encourage 'zone-based' care for {混合肌|こんごうはだ}, applying different products to different parts of the face.
- Frequently appears in labels and recommendations: {混合肌|こんごうはだ}{用|よう} ('for combination skin'), {混合肌|こんごうはだ}におすすめ ('recommended for combination skin').
- Considered one of the most common skin types, especially in humid climates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}{用|よう}の{化粧水|けしょうすい}: toner for combination skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}のスキンケア: skincare for combination skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}{向|む}けの{製品|せいひん}: products aimed at combination skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}の{悩|なや}み: concerns of those with combination skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}: oily skin — oily across the whole face.
- {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}: dry skin — dry across the whole face.
- {普通肌|ふつうはだ}: normal skin — balanced, without obvious oily or dry areas.
- {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}: sensitive skin — skin that reacts easily to products, environment, or stress.
- Tゾーン: T-zone — the forehead–nose–chin area, often the oily part of a {混合肌|こんごうはだ} face.
